intro.text: Pack-hunting predators of the Pantheon islands on First of the Sun, Patji among them, almost as big as a person.

description.text: They hunt mostly by day and follow predictable routes, unless a blooming Cakoban's finger draws them off course. They leave mounds behind where they root in the soil.

items.text: A tuskrun pack drawn by blooming Cakoban's fingers killed the trapper First of the Sky on Patji.
